modes.v0_kettle_plug: activity = kettle uses seen by the shipped detector on the kettle's own plug (REFIT kettle IAM)
modes.v1_whole_home: activity = cycles the shipped detector labels human (human=True) on the whole-home Aggregate channel

definitions.day: 04:00 to 04:00 local time (Europe/London); first activity = first human evidence after 04:00
definitions.evaluated_day: a day with >=90% of 04:00-14:00 covered by data (no gap > 120 s); if the deadline is after 14:00 the whole 04:00-24:00 must be >=90% covered
definitions.rolling_model: RhythmModel(policy) whose baseline(date) only uses evaluated days before that date, within policy.window_days; while learning (< learn_days days) the default deadline applies
definitions.checkin: first activity after the deadline (late_start) or no activity at all that day (no_activity_all_day); REFIT has no real incidents, so every check-in is a false alarm
definitions.away_paused: ASSUMPTION: days with no activity at all are treated as 'away' (in production the person can pause Kettle when travelling), so they count neither as check-ins nor as monitored days
definitions.time_to_first_checkin_after_usual: deadline - usual time on days with a learned baseline: how long after their usual start Kettle would first ask a person who did not get up

provenance.citation: Murray, D., Stankovic, L. & Stankovic, V. (2017). An electrical load measurements dataset of United Kingdom households from a two-year longitudinal study. Scientific Data 4, 160122. doi:10.1038/sdata.2016.122
provenance.time_zone: Europe/London (REFIT Unix column is local wall-clock time; see docs/refit-evaluation.md)
